acceptanceCriteria: Each named site either bounds every wait after a group signal (TERM, bounded KILL escalation, bounded final wait) or proves the group is retired before any further group signal; no killpg/Kill(-pgid) is sent after the leader has been reaped (pgid reuse).

script/qualify-checkpoint-handoff.py, script/measure-lsp-quality.py and script/qualify-lsp.py have no unbounded communicate() after killpg; an interruption test or scripted witness shows bounded return with a lingering descendant.

tools/beamfall-shadow (process_unix.go, wrapper/main.go) and tools/ci-test-slices/procgroup_unix.go send no group signal after Wait returns; focused tests pin kill-then-reap order, as PGO-V0-012 does for internal/cem/gitrun.
Any site that cannot prove retirement reports an explicit unsupported/HOLD outcome instead of silently succeeding.
body: Found 2026-10-15 by the cem1-producer-harness-cleanup lane (PR #906, inventory in docs/build-log/2026-10-14-cem1-producer-harness-cleanup.md). The harness-role paths (gitrun stable runner, groupreap, interop stable_process, procgroup, assemble-stable, cem-citation-baseline) are clean and pinned by PGO-V0-012, but the same defect class remains outside that role: (1) script/qualify-checkpoint-handoff.py: bounded communicate(timeout=90), then killpg, then an unbounded communicate(); (2) script/measure-lsp-quality.py and script/qualify-lsp.py: killpg then unbounded communicate(); (3) tools/beamfall-shadow/process_unix.go and tools/beamfall-shadow/wrapper/main.go: group signals after Wait (pgid reuse risk); (4) tools/ci-test-slices/procgroup_unix.go: cmd.Cancel group signal can race the reap. Suspected from code inspection; no runtime reproduction retained. Related: V1-0610 (scratch wrapper interruption), V1-1374/V1-1244 (procgroup flakes).
title: Process-group cleanup outside the producer harness: unbounded wait after killpg and group signals after reap
